title: List the differences between two folder trees
summary: Compare two folders file by file. Get a list of files that exist on only one side, files that exist on both but differ, and a preview of what a sync would change, without changing anything.

aliases.text: list files only in one folder
find missing files between two folders
найти файлы которых нет во второй папке

steps.explain: Compare the two folder trees. -r looks inside every subfolder, -q prints only the names of the differences. No output means the trees are identical.
steps.expect: Lines 'Only in <DIR_A>/sub: name' and 'Files a and b differ'. No output means identical.

placeholders.name: DIR_B
placeholders.description: Second folder, for example a backup copy

steps.explain: Show only the files that exist on one side. The side named in the line is the one that has the file.

placeholders.name: DIR_B
placeholders.description: Second folder, for example a backup copy

steps.explain: Show only the files that exist on both sides but have different content.
steps.expect: Lines beginning with 'Files' and ending in 'differ'.

placeholders.name: DIR_B
placeholders.description: Second folder, for example a backup copy

steps.explain: Look at one differing file line by line. Lines starting with - are only in the first file, and lines starting with + are only in the second.
steps.expect: Lines with @@ headers and - or + lines.

placeholders.name: FILE_B
placeholders.description: Same file in the second folder

steps.explain: Preview what a sync from the first folder to the second would change, without changing anything. -i lists every change: >f is a file to copy, and *deleting is a file that the second folder has and the first does not.
steps.expect: An itemized list of the planned changes. Nothing is copied or deleted.
